Skin temperature probe with biocompatible baby contact material
2/4 of the castors should have brakes

Settings with facility to clearly display the selected mode
Provision for Set temperature range (in servo mode)

The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. % of contract price per annum.
